description: Figure 3 is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating dataset statistics across four writing genres, with separate bars for “Open” (Open-Ended sets) and “Cons.” (Constrained sets). The horizontal axis contains the genre categories labeled, from left to right, “Argumentative,” “Narrative,” “Descriptive,” and “Expository,” and the vertical axis is a numeric count scale shown with evenly spaced tick marks from 0 up to 120 in increments of 20. Each genre has two adjacent bars: a light blue bar for Open and a light pink bar for Cons., as indicated by the legend in the upper right. The bars have value labels above them: for Argumentative, Open is 79 and Cons. is 122; for Narrative, Open is 80 and Cons. is 87; for Descriptive, Open is 68 and Cons. is 100; for Expository, Open is 62 and Cons. is 130. The bars are arranged by genre (not sorted by bar height), and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color coding and the numeric annotations.
